name: Lawyer & Legal
tagline: Credible, composed portraits for firms and practices.
description: Portraits that say trustworthy counsel: law libraries, courthouse steps, conference rooms and classic studio headshots. Dark tailoring and calm, confident expressions for firm websites, directory listings and speaker bios, plus a warmer, approachable option for family and community practices.
